# project-nihon

Open-source sandbox MMORPG where players build a civilization. The world is persistent, expands over time, and evolves through player interaction. This fabric encodes the game's design bible — materials, skills, items, creatures, and world systems — as a single source of truth.

## Appearance

- [BoarRider](entities/boarrider.md) — A quadruped boar — the same character system driving a non-humanoid skeleton
- [NoviceFeminine](entities/novicefeminine.md) — The feminine character-creation preset: a chibi body in the plain clothes painted on its sheet
- [NoviceMasculine](entities/novicemasculine.md) — The masculine character-creation preset: a chibi body in the plain clothes painted on its sheet
- [TravellerHuman](entities/travellerhuman.md) — The default humanoid traveller: veilsteel chestplate, a sheathed veilsteel longsword, and a stored ferrite shield

## Attribute

- [AttributeSystem](entities/attributesystem.md) — The six character attributes (Strength, Vitality, Resistance, Agility, Intelligence, Perception), what each one feeds, and how skill use grows them

## Biome

- [Alpine](entities/alpine.md) — Snow-capped peaks above the tree line, which falls toward the poles
- [Beach](entities/beach.md) — The first metre and a half of shore above the waterline: pale sand and no trees
- [Desert](entities/desert.md) — Hot, dry sand and rock: the dry half of the tropics
- [Ocean](entities/ocean.md) — Open water over the continental shelf and the deep basins
- [Savanna](entities/savanna.md) — Warm grassland with scattered trees in the seasonal tropics
- [Taiga](entities/taiga.md) — Cold, wet conifer forest between the tundra and the temperate belt
- [TemperateForest](entities/temperateforest.md) — Broad mixed-leaf forests covering most mid-latitude landmass
- [TemperateGrassland](entities/temperategrassland.md) — Open rolling plains ideal for large settlements, agriculture, and mounted travel
- [Tundra](entities/tundra.md) — Frozen, treeless plains at the high latitudes, down to the polar ice
- [TwilightGrove](entities/twilightgrove.md) — Eerie glades where day-night cycles run at an accelerated, unpredictable rate, bathing the land in perpetual half-light
- [VoidRift](entities/voidrift.md) — Fractured terrain surrounding permanent rifts in the fabric of reality
- [VolcanicBadlands](entities/volcanicbadlands.md) — Barren, heat-scorched terrain surrounding active or dormant volcanic calderas

- [Stockpile](entities/stockpile.md) — The container a settlement's members fill and draw from together

## Decision

- [ClansAndOwnedStructures](entities/clansandownedstructures.md) — A player founds a clan by choosing its name and invites other players; a clan has any number of members, a player belongs to at most one, and every member sees every other member's skills
- [DestructibleBuildings](entities/destructiblebuildings.md) — Buildings are destructible through game systems (fire, siege, structural failure) — not by arbitrary designer flags
- [DurabilityAndDestruction](entities/durabilityanddestruction.md) — Every material has a durability, higher for rarer materials, that falls with weather, time and damage
- [EarthScaleHeights](entities/earthscaleheights.md) — Peaks reach about 8,850 m (Everest is 8,849 m) and buildings up to 163 floors of 3 m
- [FictionalMaterials](entities/fictionalmaterials.md) — Fictional materials with unique properties replace real-world counterparts, giving the world consistent internal lore and design freedom
- [GodotEngine](entities/godotengine.md) — Use Godot 4.x as the game client engine
- [KnowledgeByExperimentation](entities/knowledgebyexperimentation.md) — Knowledge is discovered through experimentation — recipes, materials, and world secrets are not handed to players via tooltips or vendors
- [MagicBalancedWithMartial](entities/magicbalancedwithmartial.md) — Magic and martial combat are balanced — no archetype dominates; each has unique trade-offs and counters
- [NoTeleportation](entities/noteleportation.md) — No teleportation; infrastructure replaces fast travel
- [OfflinePlayerNpcs](entities/offlineplayernpcs.md) — Offline players may be represented in the world as configurable service NPCs, keeping shops and services running in their absence
- [OnePersistentWorld](entities/onepersistentworld.md) — A single persistent official world server
- [PlayerIdentityModel](entities/playeridentitymodel.md) — A player identity is a server-issued local UUID (player_id), not an account
- [ResearchSharedByWriting](entities/researchsharedbywriting.md) — Research is per player and is shared only by writing: a Book teaches one researched technology and a Blueprint one structure or station recipe
- [SettlementClaimAndDecay](entities/settlementclaimanddecay.md) — Settlements claim land around a Hearth, with a radius that only grows with tier
- [SettlementRaidsAndUpkeep](entities/settlementraidsandupkeep.md) — Superseded 2026-10-31 by SkillsGrowFromWork: raids are deferred and upkeep is removed (Phase 203)
- [SkillsGrowFromWork](entities/skillsgrowfromwork.md) — Crafting, gathering, building, dismantling and repairing grow the worker's own skill for that kind of work (sewing makes you a better sewer)
- [WaystonesAmendNoTeleportation](entities/waystonesamendnoteleportation.md) — Amends NoTeleportation: waystones are the one sanctioned fast travel

## Material

- [Aethermite](entities/aethermite.md) — Pale silver ore that hums faintly in the presence of active magic

- [Snow](entities/snow.md) — Packed snow that caps alpine peaks and the polar ground

- [Voidite](entities/voidite.md) — Jet-black crystalline ore found only in void-touched biomes and deep rifts

## Profession

- [Alchemist](entities/alchemist.md) — A reagent crafter who supplements alchemy knowledge with arcane forging to produce the most potent catalysts and consumables
- [Arcanist](entities/arcanist.md) — A practitioner who has married elemental control with enchanting craft, producing the most potent magical items and wielding area-control spells in combat
- [Blacksmith](entities/blacksmith.md) — Dedicated metalworker who has combined standard smithing with arcane forging techniques
- [Merchant](entities/merchant.md) — A commercial specialist who leverages trade acumen, diplomatic connections, and speechcraft to dominate NPC and player-to-NPC markets
- [Pathfinder](entities/pathfinder.md) — An expert scout and guide who can navigate any terrain invisibly, chart it accurately, and lead groups at full speed
- [Ranger](entities/ranger.md) — A wilderness specialist who combines ranged combat with reading the environment
- [VoidTouched](entities/voidtouched.md) — A rare hybrid who has survived void exposure and mastered both its magic and its smithing
- [Warrior](entities/warrior.md) — A frontline combatant who has mastered both offensive bladework and defensive shieldcraft

## Skill

- [Alchemy](entities/alchemy.md) — Brewing potions, reagents, poisons, and catalysts from raw materials
- [ArcaneForging](entities/arcaneforging.md) — Specialized metalworking at arcane forges that processes magical materials — primarily Aethermite — which shatter in standard forges
- [Archery](entities/archery.md) — Proficiency with bows and crossbows, covering aim stability, draw timing, and trajectory reading
- [Building](entities/building.md) — Putting up and taking down structures: placing blocks, dismantling them cleanly and repairing worn ones
- [Carpentry](entities/carpentry.md) — Working with Thornwood, Duskfiber, and other woody materials to craft furniture, structural building components, hafts, bows, and vehicles
- [Cartography](entities/cartography.md) — Charting unexplored territories and producing maps that can be sold or shared with other players
- [Diplomacy](entities/diplomacy.md) — Negotiating with NPC factions, guilds, and governing bodies to obtain favourable terms, treaties, or permissions
- [ElementalMagic](entities/elementalmagic.md) — Manipulation of the four classical elements — fire, earth, air, and water
- [Enchanting](entities/enchanting.md) — Imbuing refined items and materials with persistent magical effects using aethermite catalysts
- [Foraging](entities/foraging.md) — Gathering plants, herbs and fruit by hand
- [Leadership](entities/leadership.md) — Inspiring and coordinating allies in combat and in civic roles
- [Lockpicking](entities/lockpicking.md) — Opening a locked chest or door without breaking it
- [Mining](entities/mining.md) — Breaking stone, ore and soil with a pick or a shovel
- [Navigation](entities/navigation.md) — Wayfinding without landmarks using stars, moss growth, wind direction, and terrain features
- [RestorationMagic](entities/restorationmagic.md) — Healing, shielding, and cleansing magic
- [Shieldcraft](entities/shieldcraft.md) — Techniques for using a shield offensively and defensively — blocking, parrying, bashing, and forming protective stances
- [Skinning](entities/skinning.md) — Working a creature body with a knife or bone tool
- [Smithing](entities/smithing.md) — Metalworking at a forge — shaping ingots into weapons, armor, and structural components
- [Speechcraft](entities/speechcraft.md) — Persuasion, intimidation, and deception aimed at NPC targets
- [Stealth](entities/stealth.md) — Moving, hiding, and acting without detection
- [Swordsmanship](entities/swordsmanship.md) — Mastery of bladed weapons — from crude ferrite daggers to enchanted veilsteel longswords
- [Tailoring](entities/tailoring.md) — Sewing hides, fibre and cloth into clothing, bags and soft furnishings
- [Tracking](entities/tracking.md) — Reading environmental signs — footprints, disturbed foliage, scent trails — to follow creatures or players across terrain
- [Trade](entities/trade.md) — Commercial acumen that improves buy/sell spreads with NPC vendors and enables merchant-tier operations like bulk deals, consignment, and market stalls
- [Unarmed](entities/unarmed.md) — Hand-to-hand fighting techniques including strikes, grapples, and throws
- [VoidMagic](entities/voidmagic.md) — Channelling of void energy — entropic, corrupting, and capable of bypassing conventional magical resistance
- [VoidSmithing](entities/voidsmithing.md) — Esoteric art of working with void-touched materials, primarily Voidite, inside a specially shielded forge room
- [Woodcutting](entities/woodcutting.md) — Felling trees and cutting wood with an axe

## System

- [BelievableNotRealistic](entities/believablenotrealistic.md) — Believable, not realistic — the world has internal consistency and lore logic rather than real-world physics fidelity
- [CivilizationIsPlayerMade](entities/civilizationisplayermade.md) — Civilization is player-made — towns, governments, economies, and infrastructure are built and maintained by players
- [CommunityOwnsTheFuture](entities/communityownsthefuture.md) — Community owns the future — the game is open-source and its direction is shaped by contributor consensus
- [DeathSignal](entities/deathsignal.md) — System that propagates entity-death events across all subsystems
- [EverythingHasTradeoffs](entities/everythinghastradeoffs.md) — Everything has trade-offs — no dominant strategy; every choice sacrifices something
- [FreedomComesFirst](entities/freedomcomesfirst.md) — Freedom comes first — players choose who to be, what to build, and how to play without imposed class or story restrictions
- [KnowledgeIsProgression](entities/knowledgeisprogression.md) — Knowledge is progression — players advance by discovering how the world works, not by grinding XP bars
- [MonetizationRules](entities/monetizationrules.md) — Monetization policy for Project Nihon: fair, transparent, and never pay-to-win
- [NoPayToWin](entities/nopaytowin.md) — No pay-to-win — monetary transactions never grant gameplay advantages over non-paying players
- [PlayersAreTheContent](entities/playersarethecontent.md) — Players are the content — there are no scripted quests; the world is shaped entirely by player action, economy, and politics
- [SystemsOverScripts](entities/systemsoverscripts.md) — Systems over scripts — dynamic simulation rules produce emergent outcomes rather than authored event sequences
- [TheWorldIsPersistent](entities/theworldispersistent.md) — The world is persistent — changes made by players endure; nothing resets without deliberate world-event mechanics

## Technology

- [TechAlchemy](entities/techalchemy.md) — Basic alchemical knowledge
- [TechArcaneForging](entities/techarcaneforging.md) — Magical metallurgy principles
- [TechBasicCarpentry](entities/techbasiccarpentry.md) — Foundation woodworking knowledge
- [TechBasicSmithing](entities/techbasicsmithing.md) — Foundational metalworking knowledge
- [TechConcrete](entities/techconcrete.md) — Grinding ashite to cement and casting it with soil
- [TechLeyframe](entities/techleyframe.md) — Binding a steel lattice with aethermite at an arcane forge
- [TechMasterForge](entities/techmasterforge.md) — Advanced forge construction and temperature-control techniques
- [TechSteel](entities/techsteel.md) — Rolling ferrite into beams over a master forge
- [TechStoneTools](entities/techstonetools.md) — Lashing a stone to a branch
- [TechTextileWeaving](entities/techtextileweaving.md) — Fiber processing and loom construction techniques
- [TechVoidMastery](entities/techvoidmastery.md) — Esoteric void-smithing and void-brewing techniques

## Terrain_material

- [TerrainDirt](entities/terraindirt.md) — Dry brown soil and ash: the volcanic badlands
- [TerrainGrass](entities/terraingrass.md) — Short green turf: the ground of the temperate belt, the taiga and the savanna
- [TerrainMoss](entities/terrainmoss.md) — Mossy forest floor under the twilight canopy
- [TerrainMud](entities/terrainmud.md) — Wet dark mud along lake shores and river banks
- [TerrainRock](entities/terrainrock.md) — Bare grey rock: cliffs and steep slopes everywhere, and the floor of the void rift
- [TerrainSand](entities/terrainsand.md) — Pale sand: beaches, deserts and the sea floor
- [TerrainSnow](entities/terrainsnow.md) — Packed snow: the tundra, the alpine peaks and any ground above its biome's snow line

## Tutorial

- [Tutorial](entities/tutorial.md) — The first-steps tutorial: an ordered list of small steps that teach a new player, who starts with nothing, to move, pick up branches and stones, make stone tools, build the first stations, make a shelter with a bed, hunt, stay alive, find their way, grow and meet other people

## World-system

- [BedSpawn](entities/bedspawn.md) — A bed a player places becomes where they come back after death
- [CharacterRoster](entities/characterroster.md) — Several characters per player (Phase 226)
- [ChestsAndDoors](entities/chestsanddoors.md) — Chests and doors open for their owner only, their clan or everyone, as the owner sets
- [Clan](entities/clan.md) — A group of players under a name one of them chose
- [ClanTiers](entities/clantiers.md) — A clan's tier, from every building it owns wherever it stands, weighed by how durable and how rare each block's material is
- [CombatCombos](entities/combatcombos.md) — Attack combos and hit timing: per weapon class the clip order, the window that keeps a chain going, the damage multiplier and impact time of each step, the stagger share and the knock-back of a struck target
- [CombatSystem](entities/combatsystem.md) — Defines the rules governing all combat interactions — player vs creature, player vs player, and structure damage
- [DigBrush](entities/digbrush.md) — What a dig removes (Phase 300): per held tool a brush shape, a radius that grows with the Mining skill up to a cap, and the materials it cuts, plus the volume of one yielded unit per material
- [Equipment](entities/equipment.md) — Equipment categories and traits (Phase 295): every held item is equipment of a category, and what it can do in the world (fell, mine, dig, build, pick a lock, dissect, cut bone) follows from its traits by the work table
- [GearTiers](entities/geartiers.md) — Skills capped by the gear (Phase 229): a combat ability needs an equipped weapon of its tier, and a recipe needs a tool and a crafting station of its tier
- [GovernanceSystem](entities/governancesystem.md) — Defines the rules of in-game community governance
- [MarketSystem](entities/marketsystem.md) — Defines the rules of the persistent player-run market
- [NewcomerGrounds](entities/newcomergrounds.md) — Where a new character starts: a few large, gentle grounds on the open continent with trees, rock and soil in reach, only weak creatures, loose stones and branches on the ground, and a protected centre
- [PersistenceSystem](entities/persistencesystem.md) — Defines the authoritative save lifecycle: which directory the world and per-player records live in, how often the server autosaves, how a headless server is asked to shut down cleanly, and how a record is written so a kill mid-write cannot truncate it
- [RemoteMotion](entities/remotemotion.md) — How a client draws bodies it does not simulate (other players, creatures): it keeps the host's last states, plays them back a buffer behind, moves the body between them every frame, extrapolates a late state for at most one send interval, snaps only across a teleport, turns the body at a turn rate and picks idle, walk or run from the speed played back
- [ResearchPointRule](entities/researchpointrule.md) — Points of research a player earns per source: a craft, a gathered resource, and a one-time bonus for the first craft of each recipe
- [SelfRespawn](entities/selfrespawn.md) — Any player may kill their own character to respawn at their bed or the world spawn, with the normal death rules, from a command or a menu button, so no one can be trapped inside another's structure
- [Settlement](entities/settlement.md) — A player-founded village: a Hearth, members with roles and a shared Stockpile
- [SettlementProjects](entities/settlementprojects.md) — Structures a village builds together: a palisade, a storehouse, a workshop, a watchtower
- [SettlementSpecialties](entities/settlementspecialties.md) — What each member of a village is good at: woodworker, smith, hunter, builder or forager
- [SkillFocus](entities/skillfocus.md) — Dedication: XP in a skill is multiplied by 1 + maxBonus x (active minutes in the last focus window) / window, counted in play time
- [SkillWheel](entities/skillwheel.md) — The skill wheel: each skill tier is a node with an affinity per profession (which pulls it toward that profession on the rim) and a depth (how far from the centre it sits), plus what the tier unlocks
- [SoundEvents](entities/soundevents.md) — The sound event table: gameplay plays an event id, which names the asset key, the audio bus, whether it is positional, how many variants it picks from, its base volume and its pitch jitter
- [StationPlacement](entities/stationplacement.md) — Every station is an item: crafted (the first by hand, the rest at an earlier station), carried in the pack, placed from the hotbar and picked up again by its owner
- [StoneTools](entities/stonetools.md) — The stone tools a newcomer makes by hand (the only tools made or repaired without a bench), the two inputs they take, and where those inputs come from: branches from a felled tree, loose stones knocked from host rock
- [Structure](entities/structure.md) — A connected set of placed blocks and the stations on them, owned by its builder or the builder's clan
- [StructureDurability](entities/structuredurability.md) — How a placed block wears and comes apart
- [Titles](entities/titles.md) — Titles: names shown under a player
- [TradeSystem](entities/tradesystem.md) — Defines the rules governing player-to-player trade
- [WaystoneTravel](entities/waystonetravel.md) — Fast travel between waystones: a player attunes to a stone by standing at it, then travels between two attuned stones for a cost in items per 1,000 km, once per cooldown
- [WeatherSystem](entities/weathersystem.md) — Simulates weather across biomes as an emergent world system
- [WorkClips](entities/workclips.md) — Which rig clip each kind of work plays (loop for a hold, once for a single action), and the fraction of the clip at which the strike lands
- [WorkSkills](entities/workskills.md) — Which skill each kind of work grows, and by how much: crafting in each domain, gathering each family of material, plants and carcasses, building, dismantling, repairing and picking locks
- [WorkTimes](entities/worktimes.md) — How long gathering takes: a base time per material, the work each action wants (the held item's speed at it comes from Equipment.workTraits), and the slow factor of bare hands (also the speed of an item that cannot do the work)
- [WorldSystem](entities/worldsystem.md) — The planet as a fact of the fabric

## Writing

- [Blueprint](entities/blueprint.md) — A drawing of one structure or station recipe
- [Book](entities/book.md) — A written account of one researched technology
